Visualizations Choices¶

Visual 1¶

In [31]:
gender_colors = {
    0: "#cedef7",   # male
    1: "#f7d3ce" # female
}
In [33]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
fig.suptitle('Depression and Anxiety Levels in Relation to Social Media Usage', fontsize=19)

# Anxiety Levels Plot
sns.lineplot(
    data=df,
    ax=axes[0],
    x='Time_on_Social_Media',
    y='Anxiety_Level',
    hue='Gender',
    palette=gender_colors,
    errorbar=None,
    linewidth=2.5)
axes[0].set_title('Social Media Usage vs Anxiety Levels', fontsize=15)
axes[0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)


# Depression Levels Plot
sns.lineplot(
    data=df,
    ax=axes[1],
    x='Time_on_Social_Media',
    y='Depression_Level',
    hue='Gender',
    palette=gender_colors,
    errorbar=None,
    linewidth=2.5)
axes[1].set_title('Social Media Usage vs Depression Levels', fontsize=15)
axes[1].yaxis.tick_right()
axes[1].yaxis.set_label_position("right")
axes[1].spines['right'].set_visible(True)
axes[1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)


# legend labels
labels = ['Male' if lab == '0' else 'Female' for lab in axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()[1]]
axes[0].legend(title="Gender", labels=labels)
axes[1].legend(title="Gender", labels=labels)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Choice 3¶

In [41]:
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

corr = df.corr()
colors = ["black", "#F7E7CE", "black"] 
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("custom_heatmap", colors)
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr, dtype=bool))

threshold = 0.05

# for annotating only if correlation is not zero
annot_matrix = corr.apply(lambda col: col.map(lambda x: f"{x:.1f}" if abs(x) >= threshold else ""))

ax = sns.heatmap(
    data=corr,
    mask=mask,
    cmap=cmap,  
    vmin=-1, 
    vmax=1,
    center=0,
    annot=annot_matrix, 
    fmt="",
    cbar=True,
    square=True,
    linewidths=.6
)


ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

plt.show()

Choice 4¶

In [43]:
cols = ['Daily_Usage_Hours', 'Sleep_Hours', 'Academic_Performance',
        'Social_Interactions', 'Exercise_Hours', 'Anxiety_Level',
        'Depression_Level', 'Self_Esteem', 'Screen_Time_Before_Bed',
        'Phone_Checks_Per_Day', 'Time_on_Social_Media', 'Addiction_Level']


fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 3, figsize=(16, 12))
axes = axes.flatten()
fig.suptitle('Density Distribution of Various Varibles', fontsize=18)

color = "#F7E7CE"

for i, col in enumerate(cols):
    sns.kdeplot(data=df[col], ax=axes[i], color=color, fill=True, alpha=0.6, lw=2)
    axes[i].set_title(col, fontsize=14)
    axes[i].set_xlabel('')
    axes[i].set_ylabel('')
    axes[i].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
    sns.despine(ax=axes[i]) 


plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.show()

Choice 5¶

In [46]:
main_var = 'Addiction_Level'
cols_y = ['Daily_Usage_Hours', 'Time_on_Social_Media', 'Sleep_Hours', 'Phone_Checks_Per_Day']

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 10))
axes = axes.flatten()

line_color = "#F7E7CE"

for i in range(len(cols_y)):
    sns.lineplot(
        data=df,
        x=main_var,
        y=cols_y[i],
        ax=axes[i],
        color=line_color,
        lw=2, # make it thicker line
    )
    axes[i].set_title(f'Relationship between {main_var} and {cols_y[i]}', fontsize=16)
    axes[i].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)  
    axes[i].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)

    sns.regplot(data=df, x=main_var, y=cols_y[i], ax=axes[i], color="#654f60", lowess=True, scatter=False)


    if (i==1 or i==3):
        axes[i].yaxis.tick_right()
        axes[i].yaxis.set_label_position("right")
        axes[i].spines['right'].set_visible(True)
        


plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95]) 
plt.show()
